description: Default capability for the main window. Adds core:event permissions on top of Tauri's auto-generated core:default, which already covers invoking the app's own #[tauri::command] handlers but does not include permission for the frontend to call listen() (§12 'use Tauri's event system to stream progress/tokens back to the frontend'). Without this, event.listen() throws synchronously and assistant_ask_stream is never invoked at all.
